fix: B3 <-> CoD4x integration (Block 16): one switch "hide B3 commands" wires the b3hide core plugin and the eBc-B3 auth plugin together with B3's command prefix "!" and one level threshold (a B3 group). B3 now gets the RCON password from the vault inside the B3 start scope (b3.xml, mode 0600); optional !auth passwords per level live in the vault (kind b3auth) and are written to plugin_auth.ini (0600) for levels at or above the threshold; typed !auth passwords are redacted from every log view. Every gap blocks the start with a named code (b3hide missing/unapproved/changed/wrong platform, RCON password missing, vault locked, auth plugin missing). The b3hide status format (names cut to 15 bytes, no connection state) is parsed for the online list, the live kick and the phone actions. Restart hints when settings or credentials changed since the start; nothing restarts automatically.

Native WSL check (scripts/verify-4.18.20-b3-integration-native.mjs) against the real CoD4x 21.2 core with the official 21.2 release b3hide.so, eBc-B3 and two bots.
